summary: Tested Poultry Farm Management App (backend + frontend). All 20 backend pytest tests passed (auth, farms, stock CRUD, feed CRUD, invoices CRUD, dashboard stats, logout). Frontend e2e verified: login -> dashboard stats (3 farms), stock farm selection (3 cards), stock CRUD with weekly day field (day=7,date=2026-01-07,stock=995,dead=2 -> auto-calc left=993), language toggle EN<->Gujarati, billing page loads and invoice form opens, feed page shows 3 farm cards. App is in a strong working state.

issues: Date input uses browser's native HTML5 date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) rather than shadcn Calendar component - per testing guidelines this should ideally use shadcn calendar for consistent dark-theme UX

React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in the native <select> dropdown. Caused by dev-tooling annotation (x-ve-dynamic spans wrapping farm name text inside <option>). Will not break production but pollutes console with errors. Consider migrating Billing's farm select to a shadcn Select component.
Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription - accessibility warning (a11y).

action_items: (Optional) Replace native <select> for farm in Billing.js with shadcn Select to eliminate the <span> in <option> hydration warning.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to all Radix Dialog modals for a11y.
(Optional) Replace native HTML date inputs with shadcn Calendar/DatePicker for consistent dark-theme UX.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses `secure=False` for cookies - acceptable for preview but for production deployment should be `secure=True` and `samesite=none` when frontend/backend are on HTTPS cross-origin. Currently CORS uses single FRONTEND_URL which is fine.

Dashboard stats sums latest stock entry per farm - works but sorts by 'date' string descending; sorting by created_at would be more reliable than ISO date string (ISO date string sort happens to work but it's fragile if formats vary).

No authorization checks on stock/feed/invoice endpoints beyond authentication - any logged-in user can read/write any farm's data. Acceptable for single-tenant app but worth noting if multi-user roles ever needed.
server.py is approaching 620 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into auth.py / farms.py / stock.py / feed.py / invoices.py routers.
seed_data_creation: None - all TEST_ prefixed data was created and deleted by tests. Stock UI test entry (TEST_e2e) was left in DB (Badshah farm, day 7) - main agent may want to clean it up via UI or it can persist for demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints pass. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_poultry_api.py uses httpOnly cookie auth (no Bearer token). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_poultry_api.py -v. Stock payload requires day/date/stock/dead/left/notes (left required). Feed payload requires farm_id/date/feed_name/bags/weight/used/remaining/notes. Invoice payload requires invoice_number/date/customer_name/mobile_number/address/farm_id/items[product_name,quantity,rate,total]/subtotal/gst_amount/total/payment_status. Frontend testids: language-toggle, logout-button, nav-*, add-entry-button, save-button, entry-form, day-input, date-input, stock-input, dead-input, notes-input, etc.
rca_of_the_issue: No critical issues found. All listed minor items are cosmetic/a11y polish.
